montrey_appraisal_hall.name: Montrey Appraisal Hall
montrey_appraisal_hall.canon: Grand gothic appraisal hall of House Montrey built from pale silver granite, towering stained-glass windows, polished marble floor, and glowing blue mana sconces.

blackwood_forest_clearing.name: Blackwood Forest Clearing
blackwood_forest_clearing.canon: Ancient secluded mist-shrouded Blackwood frontier pine forest clearing with towering dark ironwood trees, soft dark loam ground covered in pine needles, and a solitary six-foot moss-covered granite boulder sitting in the center. Pure isolated wilderness, fifty paces beyond the apothecary rear yard.

oakhaven_apothecary_courtyard.name: Oakhaven Apothecary Rear Courtyard
oakhaven_apothecary_courtyard.canon: Rustic rear courtyard directly behind Rowan Thorne's apothecary shop in Oakhaven. Features weathered cedar woodpiles stacked against the timber wall, soft dirt loam ground below low roof eaves, a low cedar picket fence, and a narrow worn footpath leading into the nearby evergreen Blackwood tree line.

rowan_apothecary_shop.name: Rowan Apothecary Shop
rowan_apothecary_shop.canon: Warm rustic frontier apothecary workshop interior on Oakhaven High Street. Cedar shelves lined with corked glass herb jars along North wall, stone hearth and iron skillet in Far-Left corner, polished heavy oak service counter at Center-Right, heavy oak front door bolted with iron bars on South wall, and a narrow wooden ladder hatch leading to sleeping loft in South-West corner.

oakhaven_apothecary_loft.name: Oakhaven Apothecary Loft
oakhaven_apothecary_loft.canon: Cozy wooden attic bedroom loft directly above Rowan Thorne's apothecary shop in Oakhaven. Sloping rough-hewn cedar rafters, small circular leaded glass window on East wall overlooking distant green pine canopy and town roofs, simple straw mattress bed neatly made in North-West corner with thick wool blankets, small timber writing desk along South wall, wooden floor ladder hatch in South-West corner. Strictly isolated attic space.

white_dimension_library.name: The Infinite White Dimension Library
white_dimension_library.canon: Infinite pristine pearlescent white astral dimension left by the First Magicians, boundless polished white marble floor reflecting faint golden starlight mists, millions of colossal floating white-stone bookshelves and glowing ancient leather grimoires gently drifting in serene zero-gravity silence, absolute stillness, ethereal cyan arcane constellation rings rotating horizontally in distant white void.

oakhaven_perimeter_gate.name: Oakhaven Perimeter Gate
oakhaven_perimeter_gate.canon: Frontier wooden palisade gates of Oakhaven settlement reinforced with heavy iron bands, watchtowers with iron alarm bells, dirt road leading into dark Blackwood pines.
